<function name="SetAlignment" parent="DNotify" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Sets the alignment of the child panels in the notification</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="alignment" type="number{ContentAlignment}">The direction of the content, based on the number pad. See <page>Enums/ContentAlignment</page>.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
